text: [72] catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya #1 ma. sace . yu. ceva . katamehi catūhi nekkhammavitakkena abyāpādavitakkena avihiṃsāvitakkena sammādiṭṭhiyā imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti .
